scope: Draft video template research for story structures, hook direction, format templates, and provider export placement.

references.title: Speech Hook Openings Transcript
references.reuse_policy: Use as hook-direction evidence; rewrite in Artist OS language.
references.notes: Identifies five opening hook types: question, surprising statement, story-in-the-moment, big promise, and visual action hook.

references.title: Five-Line Story Method Transcript
references.reuse_policy: Use as story-structure evidence; rewrite in Artist OS language.
references.notes: Defines a scalable story skeleton: situation, desire, conflict, change, result.

references.title: YouTube Speaking And Script Delivery Notes Transcript
references.reuse_policy: Use as on-camera delivery and script-direction evidence; rewrite in Artist OS language.
references.notes: Identifies five creator-video delivery problems: formal voice, perfection over connection, unclear intended feeling, unsupported points, and going in cold.

references.title: Storytelling Zoom Into The Moment Transcript
references.reuse_policy: Use as scene-level storytelling direction; rewrite in Artist OS language.
references.notes: Extracts five embodiment techniques: location, action, raw thought, visible emotion, and dialogue.

references.title: Seven Cuts Editing Storytelling Transcript
references.reuse_policy: Use as edit-direction evidence; rewrite in Artist OS language.
references.notes: Extracts edit cut functions: flow cut, smash cut, jump cut, action cut, wide-medium-close pattern, match cut, and rhythm cut.
